literal_meaning: কেউ (someone) + কেটা (diminutive or emphatic form, implying a small but notable entity)
figurative_meaning_en: A notable or respectable person of importance
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে কোনো কেউকেটা নয়, সাধারণ মানুষ।
example_sentences_in_english: He is no big shot, just an ordinary person.
Everyone here thinks they are somebody.
note: Often used sarcastically to downplay someone's self-importance in Bengali colloquial speech.
